definitions.ask: Should $(cmd) substitution be provenance-gated so agent-authored prompt text never executes it?
definitions.why: Handoff and launch prompts legitimately carry macros; wholesale wrapping would break that

choices.label: Thread an authorship flag from launch paths; agent prompts skip $(cmd) but macros still expand
Wrap agent-authored prompt text in disabled regions, which also disables macro expansion there

definitions.ask: How should command-bearing keys in project-local sase/sase.yml be trust-gated?
definitions.why: Preserves per-project hooks while blocking repo-supplied command execution

choices.label: Execute local-layer commands only after a per-project, digest-pinned user acknowledgment
Ignore command-bearing keys from the project-local layer; hooks move to user/overlay config

definitions.ask: Should Jinja interpolations in workflow bash steps be shell-quoted by default?
definitions.why: Charset validation alone cannot protect line/text inputs interpolated into shell

choices.label: shlex.quote every interpolation with an explicit raw opt-out filter; update shipped macros
Only tighten macro input-type charsets; bash templates keep raw interpolation
